symptom: Takeoff FLF looks like a frog squat rubber-banding into a hanging doll with fused legs and sock feet
root_cause: Start still was a wide horse squat; last still was straight dangling legs. FLF interpolated silhouette morph, not a basketball jump.
fix: Start: tall athletic gather, feet under shoulders, slight knee bend. Last: original tucked dunk-approach airborne. Ban squat and hanging-stick pair.
prevention: Jump FLF: start and last must share a tall athletic silhouette. Wide squat vs dangling legs = morph. Last frame = tucked dunk approach, not legs hanging straight.
